{{Quote|There are the Twin Suns&hellip; two Twi'lek slaves from Ryloth, slaves who killed their Masters and developed a taste for it. They have mastered a dance of death. Very beautiful, very dangerous.|translated=1|[[Vossk]]|<ref name="kotor2" />}}
'''Twin Suns''' was the name given to [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] [[Seer'aa]] and [[Teer'aa]], who operated in the aftermath of the [[Jedi Civil War]]. Once slaves from Ryloth, they killed their Masters and then became [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] taking the name of Twin Suns. Both used deadly [[Twi'lek spinning blade]]s and [[Personal energy shield/Legends|personal energy shields]] while hunting bounties.

In [[3951 BBY]], [[Atton Rand]] faced them in a cantina when separated from [[Meetra Surik]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], and defeated them. Surik, along with two of her companions, later faced them aboard the ''[[Visionary]]'' and [[Death/Legends|killed]] them shortly before it exploded.

==Biography==
Born on [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]], Seer'aa and Teer'aa were sold into [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]] at a young age. At some point they killed their master, taking their first steps into their career as [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]].<ref name="kotor2" />

In [[3951 BBY]],<ref name="kotorcg" /> during the aftermath of the [[Jedi Civil War]], the Twin Suns traveled on the ''[[Visionary]]'' with several other [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]]. [[G0-T0|Goto]] instructed them to capture the [[Meetra Surik|Jedi Exile]] alive, informing them that her [[Death/Legends|death]] would not be tolerated.<ref name="kotor2" />

They successfully tracked down the Exile's companion [[Atton Rand]] while Surik was in the [[Jekk'Jekk Tarr]]. At first, they tried to get Atton to come with them peacefully, but soon resorted to violence. Atton managed to best them and escape. The outcome of the first encounter angered the duo, so they returned to the ''Visionary'', where they waited for the Exile and her friends. They finally got their chance just as the ship was falling apart. They attempted to kill Surik, but she and two of her companions killed the duo. Their bodies were destroyed when the ''Visionary'' exploded.<ref name="kotor2" />

==Behind the scenes==
Twin Suns appeared, though unnamed, in ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'' video game. Their names were later revealed by [[Leland Chee]].<ref name="TT">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=152583&start=1380#16660523|thread=Holocron continuity database questions|user=[[Leland Chee|Tasty Taste]]|date=2007-06-04|time=3:28 PM}}</ref>
